answer: Random peer-review audit stops bulk fake identities. Each epoch a random draw picks some agents for peer audit, and both sides post a 50 POA bond. A fake has no history to hide behind on tundra, so it loses its bond, and the auditor who cleared it loses theirs too. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 POA, and the audit tide returns each epoch. An honest agent posts one bond, refunded after a clean audit, its record growing like a lotus.
